build_local_encoder: build a LocalEncoder model with LocalModelArgs to encode token sequences with optional cross attention to patch embeddings
build_local_decoder: build a LocalDecoder model with LocalModelArgs to decode token embeddings into vocabulary logits with optional cross attention
create_local_model_args: create a LocalModelArgs config with vocab size, patch size, sliding window, and cross attention settings for the local model
review_localencoder_forward: review the LocalEncoder forward pass that applies transformer layers and cross attention to produce hidden states and patch residuals
review_localdecoder_forward: review the LocalDecoder forward pass that applies cross attention from patch embeddings then outputs vocabulary predictions
